heroSummary: Clayton County Public Schools students start the 2025–26 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025, and finish on Friday, May 22, 2026. Fall Break is October 13–17, Thanksgiving Break is November 24–28, Semester Break is December 22 through January 2, and Spring Break is April 6–10.
calendarNotes: The official Clayton County Public Schools 2025–26 calendar lists ELBC days on September 2, February 17, and March 16. ELBC days are virtual instructional days for students and planning or professional development days for teachers. January 5–6 are Professional Learning Days before students return from Semester Break.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Clayton County Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Clayton County Public Schools starts the 2025–26 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Clayton County Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 13, through Friday, October 17, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Clayton County ELBC days in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists ELBC days on September 2, 2025; February 17, 2026; and March 16, 2026. ELBC days are virtual instructional days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Clayton County Professional Learning Days in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists Professional Learning Days on Monday, January 5, and Tuesday, January 6, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the Clayton County Schools calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Download the MySchoolDates 2025–26 ICS file and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. This is a one-time import and will not update automatically if CCPS revises its calendar.

customSections.label: What Clayton Families Need to Know
customSections.content: These 2025–26 dates are the ones most likely to affect childcare, virtual learning routines, and the first day back after Semester Break.

groups.label: ELBC and professional learning
items: ELBC days are September 2, February 17, and March 16. The official calendar describes ELBC days as virtual instructional days for students and planning or professional development days for teachers.
January 5–6 are Professional Learning Days, so students do not return from Semester Break until Wednesday, January 7.

groups.label: Breaks and return dates
items: Semester Break runs December 22 through January 2. January 5–6 are staff-focused Professional Learning Days after the break.
February 16 is Presidents' Day, and February 17 is an ELBC day rather than a normal in-person school day.
